label: ACCEPT
reason: Exported functions in apps/docs/internals annotate their return type almost without exception, even trivial one-liners (markdown-schema/Icons.ts `(): string => '✅'`, Link.ts/Accordion.ts `}): string`, helpers.ts `: void`, markdown-sources.ts `Promise<MarkdownSource[]>`), so it is a deliberate style choice, not a consequence of the code; nothing enforces it (no explicit-function-return-type / explicit-module-boundary-types in packages/eslint-config-supabase/next.js, and nextjs.json sets declaration:false so no isolatedDeclarations), and the two outliers (addBaseUrlPrefix returning Root, generateReferencePages consumed by generate-sitemap.ts) are plain omissions worth a second look. Hesitated with WRONG incidental because it is a mild style nit and some non-exported helpers (ContentListings.ts listingMarkdownHref, generate-guides-markdown.ts parseFrontmatter, the generate() entry points) also skip it.
